entries.value: FICTIONAL ANSWER: The proposed clinic is 7 November 2026, 09:00-12:00. Water and kickboard arrangements should be confirmed by 5 November 2026; delivery by 08:30 on 7 November. Coach availability should be confirmed by 5 November.
FICTIONAL ANSWER: Proposed venue is Demo Training Pool. Reservation and pool access are not confirmed. Do not promise access or represent the venue as booked.
FICTIONAL ANSWER: Planning assumption supplied by the student team: 24 beginner student participants; not an actual registration count.
FICTIONAL ANSWER: Request 48 sealed 500 ml drinking-water bottles for the 24 planned participants. No price or cash alternative is supplied.
FICTIONAL ANSWER: Request a loan of 12 kickboards for 7 November 2026, 09:00-12:00; proposed return at 12:30 the same day. Loan, transport and damage responsibility are not confirmed.
FICTIONAL ANSWER: Request one qualified swimming coach for the three-hour clinic, 09:00-12:00 on 7 November. Qualification checks, safety supervision and acceptance remain to be confirmed.

FICTIONAL ANSWER: Only a written thank-you message from the student organising team is authorised. No logo placement, naming rights, exclusivity, campus access or university endorsement is authorised.
